step.prompt: /crew-spec Create spec 001 (the foundation: repository layout, Makefile with setup/dev/check/test, FastAPI app skeleton with /api/health, React/Vite skeleton, lint and type gates, CI) as the first spec from the architect's build order. Do not ask questions. Mark it Ready. Write docs/specs/001-*/spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md, wire the index, traceability and status, and finish.
step.judge: Read docs/specs/001-*/spec.md, plan.md and tasks.md. Score 5 if ACs are Given/When/Then with pinned values, the plan's first slice is a vertical slice with real file paths and a constitution check, tasks are small, ordered, name files and ACs, mark TDD where logic exists, and end with the status-update task; and the spec is wired into docs/specs/README.md, docs/04 and docs/20. Score 3 if the structure exists but ACs are untestable or tasks are coarse. Score 1 otherwise.

judge.reason: spec.md has 11 Given/When/Then ACs with pinned values (exact health body, problem+json shape, TEAMLY_ENV enum, make check order); plan.md Slice 1 is a contract→FastAPI→React vertical slice listing real paths plus a P1–P8 constitution check; tasks.md has 15 ordered tasks each naming files and ACs, TDD on T001-01/03/04/05/08, closing with T001-99 status update; the 001 row appears in docs/specs/README.md, docs/04 (pending PRD) and docs/20 (Specified).
